mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03 for FEDFUNDS as a predictor.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03 for the threshold signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% and increase in industrial production above 95.0 indicates robust labor market expansion and supply growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0% and INDPRO > 95.0, or joint signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts exceeding 560.0 thousand units signal overbuilding and potential correction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST > 560.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 for the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13200.0) indicates strong economic demand, supporting sustained corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 > 13200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 for GDPC1 as a predictor.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 for UNRATE as a predictor.

mechanism_narrative: A joint condition of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220.0) indicates accommodative policy during moderate inflation, supporting positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% and CPIAUCSL > 220.0, or joint signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, industrial production below 90.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 during a supply shock, or Rank IC < 0.03 for INDPRO as a predictor.
